meta.description: The ORVIBO Smart Emergency Button calls for help in one press: it sends an alarm to your family's phones and calls your contacts in turn until someone answers. Ultra-low power for long battery life.
se20_sec_1.cont: Alerts on your phone | Ultra-low power, long battery life
se20_sec2.shadow_bg: An accident strikes and help can't get there in time?
se20_sec2.shadow:
An elderly parent falls and gets hurt at home.
How do you find out right away?
se20_sec2.shadow2:
Your child is scared and can't remember your phone number.
How can they reach you fastest?
se20_sec2.shadow3:
At the hospital, around the neighborhood, at a care home, on the way back from school…
When you're not there and a loved one is in danger, how do they reach you in time?
se20_sec_3.se20_sec_3: Smart Emergency Button: call for help, raise the alarm
se20_sec_4.tit: When an elderly parent falls, help is one press away
se20_sec_4.cont: When an elderly person is home alone, a fall or a bad knock can happen, and dialing a phone is too fiddly and costs time. Now one press of the button sends an alarm to their children's phones to get help fast.
se20_sec_5.tit: When a child is scared, the alarm is one press away
se20_sec_5.cont: A child home alone with no one watching can run into all kinds of mishaps and may not remember their parents' numbers. What then? Now one press of the button calls the parents right away. If the call is missed, the button keeps calling the contacts on your list, in order of priority, until someone answers.
se20_sec6.se20_sec6_right:
More places to use it,
peace of mind in one step
